findings.entity: mirror reflection vs. man's actual razor position
findings.description: The reflection does not mirror the man's action. At 00:00 the man's razor is at his chin/jaw while the reflection simultaneously shows the razor at his upper lip; at 00:06 the pattern inverts - the foreground razor is clearly visible in profile at his upper lip while the reflection shows it at his chin below the lower lip. The left/right side matches in both frames, but the vertical placement is desynchronized, which a real plane mirror cannot produce; it suggests the 'reflection' was shot or composited independently of the foreground subject.
